title: The Apprenticeship of Duddy Kravitz
actors: Richard Dreyfuss, Micheline Lanctôt, Jack Warden
plot: In a bid to gain respect, the neglected younger son of a working class Jewish family in Montréal embarks on a series of get-rich-quick schemes to buy land surrounding a lake.
awards: Nominated for 1 Oscar. 4 wins & 3 nominations total
